cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a quiet coastal saltwater lido at dawn beside a low diving platform — she peels away a translucent protective sun-film from her upper arm after resting by the pool; an indoor skydiving wind tunnel lobby with a broad curved observation window — she relaxes after a flight session; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; her bedroom — standing; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a bus shelter on a quiet street — holds a cup in both hands
